title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope

meta.Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
97, 98, 99, 100...
Okay, that's enough sit-ups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm done working out for today, so I think I'll take a bath now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm?
A message?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's from Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
<Evening, Haruka!
How have you been?>

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
<I'll be performing in a new show.
I hope you get a chance to drop in for a look! It's scheduled for...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's performing at the Miyamasuzaka South Hall... That means I could stop by after practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<I hope practice is going well.
I should be able to make that showing, so break a leg.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm glad Mai's doing so well for herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Why?! Why can't I sing anymore?! It's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I worked so hard.
I never gave up, and now this happens?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka... You're a liar!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: <Thanks, Haruka! I'll do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good for you, Mai...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This means I need to keep trying my best too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I caused her, ASRUN and our agency so much trouble that time... And above all else, I ended up causing trouble for all of our fans...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But now, I'm back to being an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying and keep spreading hope to my fans and the fans of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, before I take a bath, I should go over what we'll be doing for tomorrow's stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll finally be unveiling the stage outfits our fans made for us, but we start by...

Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

Are you ready, viewers?

rows.Line:
<Yeah!>
<New stage outfits!>
<I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I take it we're all ready as well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to seeing how the outfits you designed turned out, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is a pretty big moment♪
Let's start counting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
One, two... Three!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<They're adorable!>
<Totally divine!>
<These look awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look! Look!
The skirt on mine's as fluffy as a bunch of feathers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're right...!
These turned out so much better than what I initially drew.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're gonna look amazing on stage with these!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Definitely. Not only that, it's clear that each outfit's been painstakingly made with great care.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for putting together such wonderful outfits for us...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We promise to use these to keep trying our best and spreading as much hope as possible.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Woohoo! Sooo worth the effort!>
<^^^You did an awesome job!>
<They look professionally made!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
“Professional” might even be an understatement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've sent our dressmakers out there a little something as a token of our appreciation! We hope you like what we got you all!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Thanks! I'm looking forward to it!>
<We're so glad that you like them so much!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was pretty worried about asking our fans to help us like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But it feels like we're heading in the right direction thanks to them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All their comments, the way they helped us put on our event, and now, these stage outfits...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They've given us so much already.
We have to respond by doing everything we can for them...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Once this stream's over, we can start thinking about our next...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I wanna hear you girls sing a new song while wearing these outfits!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Yeah! Everyone would go nuts if you sang a new song!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I wanna see you sing a new song in person!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They want us to sing a new song during our next show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A new song...)

This stream was really good too...
Their new outfits looked so cute... Haruka, the others and everyone who made them sounded so happy too...
That reminds me of how they had fans help put on an event in real life just the other day.
I wish I could help them out somehow...
What could I do for them...?

Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Those look adorable!
They all look so well made too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you should have no trouble dancing in these since they made them using a slightly elastic fabric, and this tulle's so pretty.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They must've put so much care into making these. It's clear just based on the attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I almost cried after I saw how amazing these were...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I really couldn't be happier...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was my first time designing anything, so I was worried about how these would turn out after they started taking shape.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the dressmakers were nice enough to give me all these suggestions and ideas to make everything look better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thanks to them, these turned out so much better than what I originally designed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to make these on my own, so I feel the utmost appreciation for our fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me too.
And we'll need to do our best to make it worth the effort for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so next... We're doing a show, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your fans might not know what to do with themselves when they see you perform in these.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, one person wrote a comment that said, “I wanna see you sing a new song in person!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A new song...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be great if we could get something ready in time for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, if we can that is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...! I completely forgot...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Until now, we've only been singing songs that were born in SEKAI or covers of existing ones...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. We're gonna have to ask someone to write something for us if we want to release a new song as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'd be nice if we could write one ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Then, wanna try writing one...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: FYI, none of us have any experience with that. Do you just know how long it takes to put an actual song together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If only we could write our own songs like Shii and her band...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Learning from people with songwriting experience, like Hoshino and her band, could make a difference, but I don't want to get in their way either.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which probably means asking someone to write one for us is our most realistic option.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. If that's the case, it's gonna take a good while to get the ball rolling since we'd have a lot to discuss beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, chin up!
Yes, I said that it won't be easy, but I didn't say that it's gonna be impossible!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Airi and I feel the same way about wanting to get a new song ready for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this will be our first time asking someone to do this for us, so I'll try doing some research on my end.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In the meantime, why don't we try coming up with some ideas regarding what kind of song we want to have written?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll try asking around too.
Let's do everything we can for our fans' sake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but we need to do this right, so let's take it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
I... I actually sent that email...!
What if they're really bothered by it...? But...
I want to be able to help them out somehow...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This order form template should work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know how much this could potentially cost now, so all that's left is for us to come up with a theme for our song.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But the question is who to ask...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ideally, we can find someone who understands who we are as a group...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm? An email? At this time...?
And it's addressed to MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<H-Hello...!
My name is Riho Hasegawa.
Thank you all for having me today!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm Haruka Kiritani.
Thank you for sending us that email. We really appreciate your offer.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<No, I just...!
In any case, again, thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I still can't believe I get to write a song for MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We're happy to hear that you're so excited about this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, you really took us by surprise.
Just as we were talking about our new song, your email pops into our inbox.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days earlier

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?!
Someone actually sent us an email saying they want to write a song for us?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Last night.
They even included a URL for another one of their songs, and I gave it a listen...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What was it like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It might be quicker to just listen to it. Mind if I just play it right now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't wait to hear what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And play...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
This song... It's dazzling...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's so bright and cheerful too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a little rough around the edges, but it's a great song! And it suits us so well as a group!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I thought so too.
Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I feel hope in this song.
I feel like I can keep going and try my best tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I say let's go for it.
I have a feeling this person can write the perfect song for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This song even feels like it's worth covering too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Since we've reached a decision, let's ask this person, Hasegawa, about writing a song for us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I've come up with something in terms of how to compensate them. Mind telling me what you all think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course! Let's discuss that before classes begin!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Minori
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We all really liked the song you sent us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I even went back to find your other videos and gave them a listen... Each song was so wonderful and they all felt like they were full of so much hope...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Thank you very much...!
H-Haruka, I can't believe you're praising them like this...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Oh no...! I-I'm so sorry, Kiritani!
The thing is... I've been a fan of yours forever...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Forever?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Y-Yes...!
The way you said, “I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!” was so cool...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That was when I decided to start making songs that have the power to give all their listeners belief in a “better tomorrow”...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That being said, not many people are listening to my songs based on my videos' low view counts...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Regardless... I still can't believe that you said you felt hope in my music, Kiritani!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Now it makes sense...
In that case, please allow me to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier knowing that you remembered what I said back then and made it a core tenet of your music.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel, Hasegawa...! What Haruka said was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since Haruka's the reason why you wanted to become an idol in the first place, Minori. You want to spread hope and make everyone believe in a better tomorrow just like her, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that sense, Minori, you and Hasegawa are like two peas in a pod.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Hanasato and I are...?!
B-But... I'm just...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, please! It's not like I know how to write songs...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Yeah, I see why we were so drawn to Hasegawa's music now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(She's just like us.
She wants genuinely wants everyone to believe in a “better tomorrow”.)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <So... Everyone from MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <M-My songs don't get very many views and I'm not exactly a pro who can create amazing songs.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <But... I promise to do everything I can to spread hope to everyone who listens...! I'm really looking forward to this opportunity to work with you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you!
So are we.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<I see...
A song that shows just how much you appreciate all the fans who've been supporting you.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We're here purely because of all of the support they've given us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For our first show on our own, we want to express our appreciation for them.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Understood!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <How about we have a slow tempo for each verse to get your feelings across while making the chorus cheerful and easy to sing together? For example...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Wait, you can come up with melodies just like that?!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Well, it's just a rough idea of what I thought it'd sound like...!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But it's so wonderful.
Plus, the key you chose sounds just right and easy for us to sing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Personally, I'd kinda prefer it if it were a little higher.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Yes!
Oh, but it might become difficult to sing if we raise it too high...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <So, if you don't mind, would it be alright if you told me more about your vocal ranges?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Vocal ranges?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How high or low your voice can go.
Most singers usually need to know how high they can sing using what kind of voice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Without knowing that, you could end up with a song that goes higher than you expect.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't even remember my own range. The last time I checked was so long ago...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been a while for me too, so there's a good chance that my range has changed...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <In that case, would it be alright if you try using this app that makes it easy to check and sending me your results?>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <You'll need to sing using your modal voice, using your falsetto and, if possible, a mixed voice.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A mixed voice?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In other words, somewhere between those two vocal registers, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, it's kinda hard to explain...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's accomplished by stretching your vocal cords like you're using your falsetto but actually making all of your vocal cords vibrate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Stretch and... Vibrate...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That might've just made things more confusing...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <If there's anything that's giving you trouble, would you like it if I helped...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Yes. I've studied vocal music a little bit, and I live right near Shibuya so I can meet at a moment's notice...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We really appreciate it.
We'll let you know once we've found a good place to record.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll be looking forward to it!>
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A karaoke place was a good idea since it'd have let us sing without causing a disturbance, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are they closed today?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For electrical maintenance it looks like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Talk about bad timing...
Wait, is this because my luck's so terrible...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry, Minori, I'm sure this is just happenstance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So why don't we just try a different karaoke place? There should be several more around here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's Sunday, so most places are gonna be packed. See all the people waiting to get into those ones? That's why I was betting on my usual hole-in-the-wall...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The rehearsal studios are probably all full too. Plus, it's almost time for...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Oh... H-Hello, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hasegawa's here!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Thank you all for waiting!
I-I've been looking forward to today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Allow us to thank you again for meeting us like this, Hasegawa. Unfortunately, you may've come all this way for...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I see... That is unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, we're sorry for making you go through all this trouble.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: No, I live just right there, so it's okay! Really!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I woke up really early today to warm up my voice too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you. But we don't have much of a choice, huh? Let's just figure out another time to do this and...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Well... If it's okay with all of you, would you like to come over to my place?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Your place?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I should have enough equipment to make it possible for me to check your vocal ranges.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, are you sure...
Won't the rest of your family be there too?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
They should be out today.
But my room may seem a bit cramped if that's alright...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (As idols, I feel like we should avoid going over to the house of someone we just met...)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That was when I decided to start making songs that have the power to give all their listeners belief in a “better tomorrow”...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, if it's okay with all of you, I'd like to accept her invitation... What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. Thanks, Hasegawa. We really appreciate your kind offer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: You're welcome...!
Riho's Room

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
S-Step right in...
Um, I know it's cramped, but please sit wherever you like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for having us!
Wow, you do have a lot of equipment here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This looks like a soundproof rug too. It's almost like we're in an actual studio.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I-It's nothing special, really... They're just things I bought with what I'd been saving...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Anyway... Wh-Why don't we start checking your vocal ranges?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work, Minori.
Here, have some water.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Haruka...
Argh... I couldn't sing low at all...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: But you were able to sing really high, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: In your case, Hinomori, your voice had this clarity that made it sound like you were whispering. And Momoi, your midrange packed such a powerful punch...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Haru... Kiritani, you have this dignifying aura about you. I was really impressed by all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having these different qualities means we could conceivably sing a wide variety of songs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, we could.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: And I promise to write songs that bring out the best of all of your voices!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
We really appreciate it, Hasegawa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm still really amazed by how you can come up with melodies in a snap! That's on top of matching it to how high our voices can go too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. Your musical knowledge seems to span so many genres. Not only do you do bright and cheerful well, but you also have so many other tools in your bag...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
I'm still nothing special, but I have been doing this for a little while now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. That sort of explains why you seem so skilled. By the way, how long have you been doing this?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Oh, I started playing with this app on my parents' tablet when I was in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: But I didn't actually start writing any songs until I started junior high.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: That was actually because of you, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa

rows.Line: <But I'm still determined to finish writing your song.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<So... Please...
Can I have a little more time...?>
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this is where you're at now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I couldn't do anything for her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not true. What you said about her supporters still being there for her must've gotten through to her...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But isn't there anything we can do?!
We can't just leave her alone like this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But we don't even know what to say at this point...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She knows she has others supporting her, but her body won't listen...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
And the state she's in... It's just like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's me... Well, past me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There was a time when I felt so “scared” that my body refused to do what it was told.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
It was a different reason, but you also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Whenever I tried to go on stage, my legs would freeze up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Please, try not to look so sad.
I managed to overcome that with everyone's help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However... That's also sort of why I don't really know what to say to her right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even after receiving so much support from so many people...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
We'll be fine, Haruka!
I'm sure you'll be back on stage after you take a short break!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: I get that you feel bad about this since you're the responsible type and all, but that's also why it might be good for you to relax more.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We'll be consulting with a specialist as well, so let's just try to get through this together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even after hearing all those kinds words and seeing so many people about it, my legs wouldn't stop shaking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were able to give you a show, Haruka, so isn't there something we can give Hasegawa...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There is that option.
However...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think what she needs most right now is some sort of proof that her song can “spread hope to others”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Minori's already told her that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is quite the conundrum...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it's become a question of how to free someone from the “fear” that's petrifying them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Miku, did you think of something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What should we do?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-What if we tickled her?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see. Her reflexes will force her to...
No, that's not what we're trying to accomplish here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What made you come up with that, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... Luka tickled me this one time when I was feeling really nervous and it did wonders for me. I was thinking that we could try doing the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha! I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It actually kinda worked, so it might be worth a try!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it's nice to hear that you like my favorite trick so much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haruka...
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <My mind wants to create, but my hands refuse to do what they're told...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know exactly how that feels...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The more you push yourself into a corner, the less your body is willing to respond...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But as much as I empathize with her, I don't know what to do about it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even when I'm the one who understands how she feels the most...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh...
A message from Mai.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: <I hope you enjoy our show tomorrow! I'm sure you'll find the venue fine, but I'll send over a map just in case!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see Mai's show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But is it okay for me to go have fun at a time like this? Right when Hasegawa's suffering so much...)
<Haaaruuukaaa!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's me, Rin♪
Here today to make everybody smile!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Rin? What are you doing here all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You seemed really down, so I came to take a look.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... I'm sorry for making you worry.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No, don't apologize! You worry about me whenever I'm in a bad place, right, Haruka?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So this is your chance to ask me for help!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But you might not need it since you've got a good head on your shoulders. I mean, you're such a great singer and dancer...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really not that great, but thank you, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, Rin, what would you do?
She's going through the exact same thing I did, but I have no idea how to help her...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <If I were you... I'd cheer myself up by having lots of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <How can you save someone when you aren't feeling very good yourself?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why I'd temporarily set aside whatever's bothering me and cheer myself up by having lots of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right.
I'd forgotten how important that is. If things went on like this, I wouldn't have had the energy to help anyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That also reminds me of how my old groupmates used to say, “You worry too much because you're the responsible type.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I think that's one of your best qualities, Haruka♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But! If you still don't feel great after taking the time to relax and have lots of fun...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then what happens?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Miku and I are gonna tickle you silly!
So if that does happen, come over to SEKAI whenever you like♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I might have to tickle you all back in return.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
We can have a big ticklefest!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rin.
I feel much better now because of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Same...
After all, we're both here to spread hope.
Outside of the Miyamasuzaka South Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What an amazing show!
Mai looked so cute as Rapunzel too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what a “modern version” of Rapunzel would be like, but I loved how comical it was. The way she became president of a wig company at the end was so priceless!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us today, Haruka. This ended up being a wonderfully fun break.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you. I mean, I sort of dropped this on all of you last minute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's fine. It was a good opportunity to be there for a fellow idol and see how she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
She made me want to try even harder!

rows.Speaker: Mai's Voice
rows.Line: Haruka! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Mai!
Is okay for you to be out here like this?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Yeah! I do have to get ready for our next showing, but I felt like I needed to properly greet all of you too.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for coming today!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you too!
It was a great experience!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked it...!
I sort of tried going the extra mile today because I knew you'll all be watching.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: By the way, how have things been for you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pretty good... But we've run into a bit of trouble recently.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Wait, trouble?
You're always free to ask me for help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
But it's pretty complicated, so I'll have to tell you another time...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Um, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I honestly believe that you and MORE MORE JUMP! can clear any hurdle that comes your way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You're where you are right now because you took every challenge head-on with everything you had, right?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: When I was having trouble, you worried about me and spoke with me the most. Be it me, our group or our fans, you never shied away from anything.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
But when you started struggling...
I couldn't do anything to help...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But Hanasato and the others in MORE MORE JUMP! were able to do something. They managed to get you back on stage.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You've all overcome so much already, so I think... No, I know you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, Mai...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What would you do when you feel stuck after doing everything you could...?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'd just keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'm able to perform in shows like this now, but I can't really be in any musicals because of my throat condition...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: So my options in terms of roles are pretty limited... That frustrated me for the longest time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But I want to do what I can for my fans. I may not be able to sing anymore, but there are other ways for me to spread hope to them...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Why?! Why can't I sing anymore?! It's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I want to keep being there for my fans by being the “idol” I want to be...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: That's probably the reason why I'm standing here right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Me, you, everyone...
I believe we're all capable of doing that because I was!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: So please... Keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mai...! Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not just for putting on a wonderful performance for us... But for encouraging us like this too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And we're not about to let her have all the fun of spreading hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to go...!
I hope we get a chance to chat more soon!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Bye bye, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Bye, Mai.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mai did such a great job of cheering us up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's take the courage she's given us to think once more about what we can do for Hasegawa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind leaving it to me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did you come up with an idea, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I think so...
It's not what you'd consider perfect...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm thinking that I should just go simple and do the one thing I can for her right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Simple? Also, what thing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it's simple. I should take this head-on with everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
As many times as necessary too.
Until my feelings get through.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You and Minori really are power idols, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's important for an idol to have that kind of power.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
An idol isn't an idol without a strong heart and powerful feelings!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So we'll be counting on you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please make it so Hasegawa has fun while making music again...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I will!
Riho's Room

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: No... I still can't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: What if I stay stuck like this forever...? What happens then...?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Huh? My phone...?
Who's calling me...?
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's try one of these benches.
I'm sure you'll like it since it's so nice out today.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Kiritani, you went out of your way to call me because of that song, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's only a part of it...
There's something else I'd like to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You shouldn't be pushing yourself so hard to create...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...
But I'll be causing all of you so much trouble if I don't finish it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's not my point.
I didn't get a chance to finish what I was saying the last time we spoke...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The truth is, Hasegawa, I went through something very similar in the past... So I'm fairly certain that I know what you're feeling right now.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Something similar...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I've never brought it up during any of our streams, but there was a time when my body wouldn't do what it was told even though my mind was ready to act...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, I became unable to stand on stage and had to leave ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This may take a while, but would you mind hearing my story...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About what happened before I joined MORE MORE JUMP!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Talking about this is reminding me of everything that happened leading up to my departure from ASRUN...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(No matter how hard I tried...
No matter what I did... Nothing worked...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why...?!
I went to the hospital and even did it just fine during practice...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why won't my legs move when I get on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Are you absolutely sure, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I... I can't be an idol anymore...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Haruka...
It's time for dinner. Won't you come down and join us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, Mom...
I want to be by myself right now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay...
Let me know if you get hungry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I will...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so sorry...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The pain I felt that time was unbearable...
The world even started turning gray...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I... I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
But I'm so glad for you...
You managed to stand back up and become an idol again, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was lucky... Incredibly lucky...
I'm able to stand on stage again because of Minori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also know all too well that not everyone can come back from something like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if I can take away one thing from that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's how your feelings can't be extinguished so easily.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: My feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
In my case, it's my love of being an idol and spreading hope to as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I gave up once and tried to erase that from my mind, but it didn't go away...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My guess is that everyone carries these sorts of feelings, including you, Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Despite all the terrible things that people have said and all that you've gone through, you still want to keep creating music.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Isn't that because you wish to spread hope to everyone more than anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That was when I decided to start making songs that have the power to give all their listeners belief in a “better tomorrow”...!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I was just trying to spread hope with my song, but I ended up hurting these people...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <My mind wants to create, but my hands refuse to do what they're told...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's easy to think that everything would be so much better if these feelings just went away...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Am I right in saying that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But each person has to face up to their feelings in their own way...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some may suffer while dwelling on what's bothering them. Others may find ways to weather the storm while slowly chipping away at their issues.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: How did you face your problems, Kiritani...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! help me deal with that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They taught me that I didn't have to carry all this weight on my own.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to be there for you, Hasegawa, just as MORE MORE JUMP! was there for me.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ultimately, how you deal with this is going to be up to you... But that doesn't mean you have to suffer all alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please ask for help if you ever think you need it. I promise to do everything in my power when you do.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Everything in your power...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For example...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's tickle time...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Eep! H-Haruka...!
Hahahaha...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm doing everything in my power to make you smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Anyway, jokes aside...
I want to help you get through whatever's bothering you, Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So again... Please ask for help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...
You really are an incredible idol, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not saying this as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, we only met just recently and talked mostly about work. Even until just now, we were discussing our new song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we aren't just coworkers or anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Because your music, Hasegawa...
Your songs make us smile, Riho.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a fan of your music, Riho, I want to take this opportunity to give back to you.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I-I'll give it another try...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good.
I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Haruka!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great job.
I didn't catch that entire conversation, but Hasegawa seemed really happy at the end there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Were you able to tell her how you feel, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes...
I told her everything I could.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, all that's left for us to do is give her time and wait.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!
Two weeks later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Today, let's discuss what we'll be doing for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
We need to start by finding a venue and estimating how many people we'll have like last time, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right! It's also gonna be all about singing, so we'll need to think of a good set list to go along with it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. It might be wise to try to get the crowd going with some covers or other songs just in case our original doesn't pan out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How do you think Hasegawa's doing right now...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope she's feeling at least a little better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too...
We haven't heard from her since... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hasegawa?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hasegawa sent us an email!
I-I'm gonna open it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What did she say?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Thank you for what you did the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I've spent a lot of time thinking after you told me your story, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <It became hard to work on my song because I was so scared that it'd end up hurting more people. However...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Even after dwelling on this for so long... I realized that I don't want to stop making my own music.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Again, Haruka, thank you very much.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Some people will keep saying mean things about me, but I want to keep doing everything I can for those who want to support me.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, there's more!
<Lastly, that song's finally complete so I'll be sending it over.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You were all there for me when I needed help, so please accept this as a small token of my appreciation. I hope you all enjoy it.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is what she wrote!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait to hear what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Minori, lay it on us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Coming right up!
Play!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
It tugs at your heartstrings even more now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's as if our individual desires to spread hope to others all came together, including Hasegawa's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! It's all thanks to you, Haruka! I knew you would...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Haruka...!
*Cry*
